_readme: Copy for Tundra's choice-payoffs-v0.2 (8015554). Tokens: {catName} = the cat speaking, {sourceName} = the cat who passed the fact on (§1.4, Tundra wrote {catName}; renamed so it's not the speaker), {playerName}, {zoneName}. No pronoun tokens, no numbers. Openers have one line per sociability band, so exactly one plays. Choice 'text' is what plays after the pick.

1.3_knows_name_opener.text: {playerName}! You came back! I hoped you would. {catName} trots over to meet you.

parts.say: {playerName}! You came back! I hoped you would.

1.3_knows_name_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.3_knows_name_opener.text: {playerName}, isn't it? {catName} says it carefully, checking it's right. You came back, then. Good.

parts.beat: {catName} says it carefully, checking it's right.

1.3_knows_name_opener.speaker: {catId}

parts.beat: {catName} doesn't get up, but an ear turns your way.

parts.say: {playerName}? You came back. Most outsiders don't bother. Well, sit, if you're staying.

1.3_knows_name_opener.text: {playerName}. {catName} doesn't come any closer. So you came back.
1.3_knows_name_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.text: Wait, are you the cat {sourceName} told me about? I was hoping I'd meet you!

parts.say: Wait, are you the cat {sourceName} told me about? I was hoping I'd meet you!

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.text: You're the cat {sourceName} told me about. {catName} looks you over, checking you against the story. Hm. Not quite what I pictured.

parts.say: You're the cat {sourceName} told me about.

parts.beat: {catName} looks you over, checking you against the story.

parts.say: Hm. Not quite what I pictured.

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.text: So you're the cat {sourceName} told me about. {catName} doesn't sound impressed.

parts.say: So you're the cat {sourceName} told me about.

1.4_pridemate_heard_opener.speaker: {catId}

opener.text: Still on your own? I keep thinking about that. Doesn't it get lonely?

parts.say: Still on your own? I keep thinking about that. Doesn't it get lonely?

opener.speaker: {catId}

opener.text: Still on your own? {catName} glances past you, as if expecting someone this time.

parts.beat: {catName} glances past you, as if expecting someone this time.

opener.speaker: {catId}

opener.text: Still alone, then. {catName} doesn't quite make it a question.

parts.beat: {catName} doesn't quite make it a question.

opener.speaker: {catId}

not_by_choice.label: “Not by choice. I'd like some company, honestly.”
not_by_choice.text: Oh. I didn't know that. {catName} goes quiet for a moment. I'll keep it in mind.

leave.label: Change the subject to the hunting.
leave.text: {catName} takes the hint and talks about prey instead.

parts.beat: {catName} takes the hint and talks about prey instead.

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.text: Someone told me you're looking for company out there. Honestly? So am I.

parts.say: Someone told me you're looking for company out there. I hope you find some.

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.text: Someone told me you're looking for company out there. I hope you find some.

parts.say: Someone told me you're looking for company out there. I hope you find some.

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.speaker: {catId}

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.text: {catName} keeps a little way off. I heard you're after company. I'm only passing on what I was told.

parts.say: Someone told me you're looking for company out there. I hope you find some.

1.5_seeking_company_gossip_opener.speaker: {catId}

text.text: Tomorrow? Yes! {catName} doesn't even stop to think. I'll be there.
{catName} thinks about it, then nods. {zoneName}, tomorrow. All right.
Maybe, if I'm passing this way. {catName} looks off to the side, but it sounds more like a yes.

say_goodbye.label: Say goodbye and go.
say_goodbye.text: Bye, then. You go your separate ways. {catName} glances back before the trail bends out of sight.

2.2_you_came.text: {catName} is already waiting and comes to meet you. You came!
{catName} is waiting at {zoneName} and gets up when you arrive. You came.
{catName} is there, trying not to look like a cat who's been waiting. Oh. You came. Good.

opener.text: I waited for you at {zoneName}. {catName} sounds more hurt than angry. Did something happen?
I waited for you at {zoneName}. {catName} waits to hear why.
{catName}'s bobtail twitches. I waited at {zoneName}. I won't make a habit of that.

explain.label: Tell {catName} what kept you.
explain.text: You tell {catName} what kept you. All right. I can understand that.

repair.label: “I'm sorry. I should have come.”
repair.text: {catName} lets it go. Thanks for saying it.

leave.label: Say nothing about it.
leave.text: You don't answer, and {catName} doesn't ask again.

opener.text: You ate that whole kill and didn't even look at me! {catName} sounds more amazed than cross.
You ate that whole kill right in front of me. {catName} says it lightly, but waits for your answer.
You ate the whole kill in front of me. {catName} clearly saw every bite.

promise_share.label: “Next time I make a kill, I'll share it with you.”
promise_share.text: {catName}'s ears come up. I'll hold you to that.

my_kill.label: “It was my kill.”
my_kill.text: Fine. It was yours. {catName} turns a little away from you.

leave.label: Let the remark pass.
leave.text: You don't answer that, and {catName} lets it drop.
